Welcome to the world of Goblin, a thrilling arcade browser game that will test your reflexes and keep you on the edge of your seat. Developed by GamePix, Goblin is a simple yet addictive game that requires you to jump from one wall to another while avoiding knives and accumulating points. sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The gameplay mechanics of Goblin are straightforward yet challenging. The objective of the game is to jump from one wall to another while avoiding knives that are thrown from the top of the screen. The player can use the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play the game. The controls are simple to use, but mastering the timing and precision required to succeed is a different story. The game becomes increasingly challenging as the level progresses, with faster knives and more obstacles to navigate.

One of the key features of Goblin is its scoring system. The player earns points for each successful jump, and the score increases exponentially as the level progresses. The goal is to achieve the highest score possible, and the game provides a leaderboard to track the top scores. The scoring system adds a competitive element to the game, encouraging players to improve their skills and compete with others.

Another important aspect of Goblin's gameplay mechanics is the power-ups. The game features various power-ups that can be collected to enhance the player's abilities. These power-ups can help the player to jump higher, move faster, or even attract knives to the player's position. The power-ups add a layer of strategy to the game, as players must decide when to use them to maximize their score.
